title: FAQ: Who is DarGlobal?
text: DarGlobal creates real estate that speaks for itself — where design, integrity, and purpose come together. We collaborate with trusted global partners to build destinations that gain meaning and value over time. For the world citizen, we offer not just investment — but belonging.

title: FAQ: What's ROI, ROE and ROL?
text: ROI (Return on Investment): measurable financial growth and lasting capital appreciation. ROE (Return on Ego): the pride, identity, and social value of owning something that reflects who you are and what you stand for. ROL (Return on Legacy): the confidence that what you build today will stand for something tomorrow.

title: FAQ: What makes DarGlobal different?
text: We deliver more than properties — we deliver results: 1. Wealth protected across cycles 2. Lifestyle defined by beauty and craftsmanship 3. Legacy that lives forward. And we build with clarity, trust, and global partnerships that elevate every development.

title: FAQ: Where does DarGlobal operate?
text: Across 14 cities in 9 countries, including Spain, London, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, the UK, and the Maldives.

title: FAQ: What types of properties do you offer?
text: We develop residences, cities, and hospitality projects in the world's most dynamic destinations. Each one is designed as both a home to live in and an investment to grow. From branded villas and penthouses to resort-style residences and city apartments.

title: FAQ: Why partner with global brands? What are co-branded residences?
text: Co-branded residences are homes crafted in collaboration with the world's most iconic luxury brands — from fashion to hospitality to design — offering elevated architecture, exclusive services, and long-term value driven by global brand equity. Brand equity drives desirability, rental performance, resale value, and long-term appreciation.

title: FAQ: Can international buyers invest?
text: Yes. DarGlobal is built for the global citizen — our destinations welcome international investors with full ownership rights, residency privileges where applicable, and secure, transparent investment frameworks.

title: FAQ: How does the buying process work? How can I invest?
text: 1. Choose your property 2. Review the investment plan with our advisors 3. Reserve your unit securely 4. Sign digitally or through our offices worldwide 5. Complete payment and registration with full support from our team. International and remote investors can complete the entire process digitally. Offices in Dubai, Riyadh, Jeddah, Muscat, Doha, London, Marbella and New York.

title: FAQ: What are the benefits of investing in off-plan luxury properties?
text: Off-plan at DarGlobal means entering early into high-growth destinations, benefiting from attractive prices, flexible payment plans, and the appreciation that comes with world-class design and brand collaborations.

title: FAQ: What kind of returns can I expect?
text: Each development is positioned for capital appreciation and strong rental yields, from premium Dubai residences to branded Marbella villas and waterfront Muscat properties. (The site gives no specific yield figures.)

title: FAQ: Is my investment secure and transparent?
text: With over three decades of delivery, DarGlobal relies on transparent processes. Every investor is protected by local regulations, escrow systems, and global partnerships.

title: FAQ: Where are DarGlobal properties located?
text: Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Muscat, Doha, Riyadh, Jeddah, Costa del Sol (Spain), the Maldives, London, and more.

title: FAQ: Which projects are open for investment? Upcoming launches?
text: Multiple developments across the UAE, Oman, KSA, Spain, London, and the Maldives are currently open, including branded districts and resort-led communities. DarGlobal continues to expand through new partnerships across the GCC, Europe, and Asia; speak with an advisor to register for upcoming launches and early access.

title: FAQ: Do properties come fully furnished or customizable?
text: Many branded residences are offered fully furnished with world-class interior design. Select projects also offer customization options.

title: FAQ: What payment plans are available?
text: Each development offers flexible installment plans. Details differ by project; see the project page or ask an advisor.

title: FAQ: How does property registration work?
text: Registration is completed with the respective land department or governing authority in each country. DarGlobal provides full guidance to ensure a smooth and compliant process.

title: FAQ: What documents are required to buy a property?
text: Typically: 1. Passport copy 2. Contact information 3. Reservation form 4. Payment details. Certain markets may require additional documentation, and advisors guide you step-by-step.

title: FAQ: How long has DarGlobal been in luxury real estate? Where is it headquartered? Is it listed?
text: DarGlobal is backed by over three decades of development experience. It is headquartered in London and operates across 14 cities in 9 countries. It is publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange (since 2023).

title: About DarGlobal
text: DarGlobal develops real estate where lifestyle and value come together, working with trusted global partners to create homes, communities and destinations. Founder & Chief Executive Officer: Ziad El Chaar. Proudly listed on the London Stock Exchange. The international portfolio spans residences, vacation retreats, world-class hospitality, and developments with luxury brands including Aston Martin and Lamborghini. Built on trust: over 31 years of luxury development experience.

title: Investor relations and leadership
text: Listed on the London Stock Exchange since 2023, building on three decades of development know-how. Portfolio spans 14 cities and 9 countries, served from hubs in New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat and Doha. Total GDV (gross development value): USD 23 BN. CEO Ziad El Chaar leads strategic expansion and partnerships; under him DarGlobal listed in London in 2023 and partnered with the Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Fendi, Pagani Automobili, Paramount and W Hotels, and diversified into hospitality across the UAE, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain and UK.

title: Why invest: visas and residency through property (Saudi Arabia, Oman)
text: Saudi Arabia: invest 4M SAR (approx 1.07M USD) to secure Saudi residency; 30-year corporate tax exemption; the riyal is pegged to the USD; investors can open a Saudi bank account on a visit visa. Oman: invest in real estate and obtain lifetime residency; easy bank account setup; 0% personal income tax; 0% import or export duties.

title: Why invest: visas and residency through property (Qatar, UAE)
text: Qatar: no personal income tax and no property tax. Permanent residency by investing 3,650,000 QAR (1 million USD). Investor Visa Program: residency for a real estate purchase of at least 728,000 QAR (200,000 USD); after payment the Ministry of Justice issues a Sanad Mabdayi (temporary title deed), so investors can apply for residency before the project is completed. UAE: invest 2 million AED (approx 545,000 USD) in real estate, now including off-plan, for a 10-year Golden Visa; 0% income tax; 0% property tax.

title: Commercial
text: A portfolio of retail districts, food and beverage destinations and mixed-use spaces. Project: Trump Plaza, Jeddah, KSA.

title: Tokenization (fractional ownership)
text: DarGlobal uses blockchain-powered tokenization: physical properties are turned into digital tokens, fractional shares that investors can buy, sell or hold. Benefits: invest in exclusive projects from anywhere; trade tokens through regulated platforms, backed by real assets; every transaction recorded on a secure blockchain; own a share of luxury residences without a traditional full purchase.

title: One of One: Premiere Edition Collection
text: A curated selection of ultra-rare residences, available on request. Includes Azure Oceanfront Villas, interiors by Fendi Casa (AIDA, Oman: five-bedroom residences 130 meters above the sea); The Albert Hall Mansion, Residences 7 & 8 (London); and The Trump Penthouse (Dubai: the only two duplex penthouses in Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai, each with a private pool facing the Burj Khalifa).

text: Aston Martin partnered with DarGlobal on The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin, in Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah, UAE: the brand's first residential project in the Gulf. Related: Top of the Astera. The main works contract was awarded to Gulf Asia Contracting in July 2025.

title: Brand partner: Fendi Casa
text: Fendi Casa partnered with DarGlobal on Azure Oceanfront Villas (AIDA, Oman, announced June 2026) and DarGlobal Mansions, Interiors by Fendi Casa (Wadi Safar, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia).

title: Brand partner: Automobili Lamborghini
text: Automobili Lamborghini partnered with DarGlobal on Tierra Viva, Design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini, in Benahavís, Spain, and on Painite Villas, Design Inspired by Automobili Lamborghini. Tierra Viva was shown at the Lamborghini Lounge Porto Cervo in summer 2025.

title: Brand partner: Marriott

title: Brand partner: Missoni

title: Brand partner: Mouawad

title: Brand partner: Pagani

title: Brand partner: The Trump Organization
text: The Trump Organization partnered with DarGlobal across Dubai, Jeddah and Muscat: The Trump Penthouses and Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai; Trump Tower Jeddah; Trump Cliff Villas, Trump International Hotel and Trump Golf Villas in Muscat, Oman. In August 2026 Gulf Asia Contracting was appointed to build Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai.

title: Brand partner: W Hotels
text: W Hotels partnered with DarGlobal on W Residences, Downtown Dubai. The main works (AED 273 million) were awarded to China State Construction Engineering Corporation Middle East in February 2023.

title: Brand partner: Paramount (Nickelodeon)
text: With Paramount, DarGlobal launched Nickelodeon Hotels & Resorts AIDA, Oman (unveiled February 2026): a family resort with themed environments, character interactions and an Aqua Nick water park.
